function.arguments: {"finding": "The email and paid_search channels have different distributions of customer_segment and customer_age. Specifically, email has a higher proportion of loyal and returning customers, and a higher proportion of older customers (50+), while paid_search has more new customers and younger customers (<30). This suggests a confounding factor: customer segment and age may influence conversion rates independently of the channel. Thus, a raw difference in conversion rates between channels may not reflect the causal effect of the campaign type.", "implication": "We cannot interpret the raw difference in conversion rates as the effect of the email campaign versus paid search without adjusting for customer segment and age. function.name: note_finding
